supplied_pdf_findings: The supplied Grade 11 formula/map/current-electricity ebooks do not contain a dedicated Chapter VI magnetic-field corpus; their visible tables of contents end at current electricity/circuits for the relevant Grade 11 volume.
BT-Chương II_1.pdf contains occurrences of 'từ trường' only in the electromagnetic-wave context, not the Chapter VI magnetostatics/current-field curriculum audited here.
BT-Chương IV_1.pdf contains only scattered mentions such as superconducting coils producing strong magnetic fields, not a Chapter VI source bank.
Therefore no learner-facing Chapter VI content was attributed to the supplied PDFs; they were used only for general corpus style where appropriate.
